errors.evidence: The description states there are nine economies, but the x-axis lists ten economies and economic blocs (Франция, Германия, Италия, Испания, България, Еврозоната, ЕС, Обединеното кралство, Турция, Русия).

errors.text_span: Всички стойности за двете тримесечия са отрицателни
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The value for Turkey (Турция) in the first quarter of 2020 (I трим. 2020) is positive, at approximately +0.5%.
The value for France in Q2 is approximately -14%, not -13% as stated.

errors.text_span: Най-малкият спад през II тримесечие се отбелязва в Русия (около -4%) и Турция (около -5%).
errors.evidence: While Russia has the smallest decline in Q2, Turkey does not have the second smallest. The value for Turkey in Q2 is approximately -10.5%, not -5%. The second smallest decline is observed in Bulgaria (около -4.5%).

errors.text_span: с изключение на България, където спадът е по-малък през II тримесечие
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the decline in Bulgaria was smaller in Q2 than in Q1. The chart shows the opposite: the decline in Q1 was approximately -4%, while the decline in Q2 was slightly larger at approximately -4.5%.
The stated values for Bulgaria are incorrect. The chart shows values of approximately -4.5% for Q2 and -4% for Q1, not -6% and -8%.
